name: Tiingo
rate_limits: Free plan: 50 requests an hour, 1,000 a day, 500 unique symbols a month (source: https://www.tiingo.com/about/pricing).
history_start: 30 or more years of end of day prices for covered securities.
what_it_has: End of day prices for over 110,000 securities on the free plan. Real time, crypto, news and fundamentals need paid plans, and forex is not in the free plan.
simple: A data company with a free plan for daily stock prices, which could be a backup for our S&P 500 benchmark.
license_terms: Internal use only: personal use, no displaying or sharing the data with anyone else. https://www.tiingo.com/about/pricing
quality_notes: Free plan has no FX. Adjusted prices are recomputed after corporate actions.

relevance.reason: A possible official backup for dividend adjusted SPY if the Yahoo endpoint breaks.
